mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a stagflationary shock, which triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in the past month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery phase (UNRATE below 4.0%), a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0% and declines by > 0.1pp in the past month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic activity, which supports corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST is above 1500, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) falls below 750,000 million dollars, it signals a slowdown in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS is below 750000, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic expansion, which boosts corporate profits and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST rises > 0.5% and INDPRO rises > 0.3% in the past month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economy (INDPRO below 100.0), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a manufacturing slowdown, which reduces corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.0 and declines by > 0.2% in the past month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
